theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → M' ⊆ M → 0 < δ → μHE[n] ((M \ M') ∩ ball x δ) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
